verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no documented public API for driving Ente Auth. Probes for OpenAPI or Swagger specs all returned 404. The nearby capabilities do not qualify: the official CLI only exports and decrypts backups, the enteauth://search deep link opens a search, and llms.txt is a site description, not an API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
